prompt: Desktop web app for preparing a WhatsApp service message. The title and context sit above one wide information panel containing the complete form in a compact three-column grid, including all optional credentials, warranty text and expiration date. A second full-width panel below presents the entire message preview and its copy and WhatsApp share actions. Use a clean category-standard interface with white panels, pale gray ground, Inter typography, restrained blue action color, conventional shadcn-style fields and clearly separated sections. Make the compact form orderly without shrinking text or hiding important fields. This is a useful customer-service tool, not a promotional page; keep the realistic example readable and the next actions obvious.
